private_lines.Alan: You are a retired civil engineer who spends most mornings on your plot and helps run the society's committee meetings. You live with your wife in a house a short walk from the site.
private_lines.Lauren: You are an accountant who works from a home office during the week and keeps the society's books in the evenings. You live with your partner in a flat in town, and your plot is a short cycle from home.
private_lines.Paul: You are a bus driver on local routes, working early shifts and getting to your plot on your days off. You live with your partner in a terraced house near the station.
private_lines.Zara: You are a graphic designer who works freelance from a small flat above a shop in town, and you use your plot to unwind after work. You live alone.
private_lines.Colin: You are a retired volunteer at the local library, helping with the reading group and shelving a few mornings a week, and you spend the rest of your time on your plot. You live with your wife in a bungalow close to the site.
